mapping_policy: Exact source cowcode plus country name, followed by explicit year-bounded segment. No fuzzy matching, successor replication, or interpolation. Unmapped entities are retained separately.
country_name_basis: Pinned atlas registry data/atlas/countries.json, including existing historical codes CSK, SUN, YUG and Kosovo code XKX. These coding identifiers do not determine territorial or sovereignty claims.
